label: Web Browser
description: Real Chromium browser tab inside UEFN Ducky — docs, dashboards, search, local dev servers, and AI-driven navigation via browser_* MCP tools. Workflows show a page with the Open in Ducky browser node. Agents take frames from any moment of a YouTube video with browser_video_frames. CDP/remote debugging is off by default so Cloudflare checks work; opt in only for chrome-devtools-mcp. Agents can also use your own Google Chrome (chrome_* tools, Chrome DevTools MCP bundled): only when you allow it in the chat, with a warning that it is your real Chrome.

settings.sections.title: Your own Chrome
settings.sections.description: Agents normally use Ducky's Browser tab. With this on, an agent you ask can also use your own Google Chrome: your real tabs and the accounts you're signed in to. Chrome needs remote debugging turned on once at chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging, and asks you to Allow each new connection.

properties.label: Let agents use my Chrome
properties.description: Off = agents only ever use Ducky's Browser tab.

properties.label: Ask me in each chat first
properties.description: The first time a chat wants your Chrome, it asks you there and says it is your real Chrome. Off = chats use it without asking (Chrome still asks you to Allow the connection).

properties.label: Debugging address (advanced)
properties.description: Leave empty to use the Chrome you have open. Only for a Chrome you started with --remote-debugging-port.

nodes.label: Open in Ducky browser
nodes.description: Shows a page in Ducky's Browser tab, opening the tab first and bringing it to the front. Works for websites and local dev servers (localhost:<port>); not for Ducky's own window. Fails when Ducky's window isn't open.

templates.label: Show a page in the Browser tab
templates.description: Opens Ducky's Browser tab on a page: a website, or a dev server you started on this PC (localhost:<port>).

nodes.label: Open in Ducky browser
nodes.description: Change the page address in this step's details.

steps.title: Web Browser ready
steps.body: The in-app Chromium browser is enabled. Open the Browser tab or ask the agent to navigate with browser_* tools.
